title: MeshMend full pre-sculpt architecture audit
prompt: High Elf Warrior with glaive, layered fantasy armor, cape, heroic posture, ornate helm, narrow waist, long limbs
first_collapse_stage: Body Generator in the pre-repair architecture: _build_category_mesh / previous High Elf branch produced ellipsoid/box/capsule/cylinder-like final parts; assembly then added capsule connectors. Concept parsing was not the first collapse. The repaired High Elf path now routes to _build_authored_high_elf_category_mesh and authored connectors before sculpting.

stage_review.why_mannequin_if_failed: This is the mandatory stop point before sculpting. If it fails, sculpting must not run.

stage_review.why_mannequin_if_failed: Sculpting a failed base decorates a mannequin rather than creating a miniature.

stage_review.geometry_representation: detail maps/stamps only after base silhouette pass

stage_review.why_mannequin_if_failed: Detail density cannot repair missing archetype shape.

failure_points: export can preserve bad geometry if upstream gates are bypassed
stage_review.why_mannequin_if_failed: Export is not causal; it only serializes the upstream failure.
